title: FIELD SKETCH - blind-b-annex (synthetic plan for the blind-transcription trial)
interpretations: Ell north wall has no stated total; the plan writes 6'-9" and 9'-10" split by a tick mark on the wall. Recorded as a chain: v = 16'-7" is my arithmetic (81" + 118" = 199"), parts are the pen values.
Ell polygon closes exactly on the stated numbers: E 199" vs W 98"+101"=199", S 85"+57"=142" vs N 142". No adjustment made.

The 8'-2" dimension is read as the interior west-running wall at the top of the L-notch, and 4'-9" as the notch's south-running wall; 8'-5" is the full bottom wall including the door opening (label centered under the whole span, and pixel proportions agree).

Door 'at' is taken as measured from the run's START corner in its direction of travel; the format says only 'corner -> near jamb' without naming which corner. Ell: the pen 3'-2" tick dimension runs from the interior SE corner (where the 4'-9" wall meets the bottom wall) to the near jamb, which is the start corner of run 4 as I ordered the runs, so it transcribes directly. Annex: the pen 3'-6" tick dimension runs from the NW corner to the near jamb, the start corner of run 0.

Hinge 'near' on both doors because the open leaf is drawn perpendicular to the wall at the near jamb (ell: leaf at the east jamb of the opening; annex: leaf at the west jamb). The format does not define hinge semantics beyond near/far, so this is a judgment call.
Door widths are the pen 'DR 3'-0"' callouts. No door heights appear anywhere on the plan; h is omitted on both doors so they build 80" flagged DEFAULT per the format.
No dimension ties the two rooms together on the plan; origin omitted on both rooms, accepting the default side-by-side placement with a 48" gap.
Wall thickness and window sill are not stated; both optional fields omitted (house defaults 4" / 48").
Annex ceiling 8'-3" is a pen value; the header note '* annex ceiling is LOWER - measured separately' is carried as a note on the value, not treated as doubt about it.

The photo is a skewed phone shot; all values are transcribed from the written pen text only, never scaled from pixels. Pixel proportions were used solely as a cross-check that labels attach to the right walls.
The plan header says this is a synthetic plan for the blind-transcription trial, not a client drawing; job name taken from the working folder (b-annex), title from the sketch header.
